faq.a: No food is included. We offer cotton candy and drinks as an add-on. Outside food and drink is allowed if you wish to cater yourself. Fridge and freezer available for your own cake and ice cream.
Fly High grip socks are required ($3). Non Fly High grip socks are subject to approval. Normal socks are not permitted.

faq.q: What if our party runs over time?
faq.a: $25 fee for every 10 minutes that table is still occupied after official party end time.

Ages 6 and up: $16 for 1 hour, $24 for 2 hours, $32 for 3 hours. Ages 3-5: $12 for 1 hour, $18 for 2 hours, $23 for 3 hours. Ages 2 and under: $4 per hour. Parent access: $10 per hour. 3 hour access includes free grip socks and 1 small fountain drink.
Ages 6 and up $34.95, ages 3-5 $24.95 per month, two hour jump time, $10 registration fee, 3-month contract (non-refundable), recurring credit card payment only.

Monday Family Night 4-9 PM 20% off; Tuesday BOGO hour; Wednesday Buddy Night 2nd ticket 1/2 off; Thursday College Night $4 off with school ID; Friday Flight Night 7-10 pm for $23. Specials may not be valid on Holidays / No School Days.
Summer hours: Monday-Thursday 10 am to 9 pm, Friday-Saturday 10 am to 10 pm, Sunday 10 am to 8 pm. Please check our Facebook/Instagram page for unexpected closures due to facility rentals.
4th of July: Close at 6pm. Oct 31: Close at 4pm. Thanksgiving: Closed. Christmas Eve: Close at 4 pm. Christmas Day: Closed. Easter: Closed.
